_about: Offline threat-intelligence snapshot used by the 'offline' enrichment provider.
It lets the whole pipeline run with no API keys and no network access, so anyone
who clones this repo can see a realistic triage immediately.
Verdicts here are illustrative fixtures, NOT live intelligence. The addresses are
that no real host is implicated by a fabricated abuse record. 203.0.113.233 and
cdn-update.xyz are stand-ins for known-bad infrastructure. 8.8.8.8 is the one genuinely
real address here - Google Public DNS - and its 'clean' verdict is the true one.
File hashes are synthetic values generated for this repo. They match no real sample and
Any indicator not listed below resolves to verdict 'unknown'.

203.0.113.233.note: Reported repeatedly as a commodity-loader C2 node.

198.51.100.30.note: Low-confidence abuse reports, mostly authentication brute-force. Not conclusive on its own - the shared-origin correlation is what makes it matter here.

192.0.2.47.note: No reputation data. Unknown is not the same as clean - it means nobody has reported it yet.

8.8.8.8.note: Google Public DNS. Well-known infrastructure, treated as benign.

cdn-update.xyz.note: Registered 9 days before the alert. Typosquat-style CDN name on a low-cost TLD.
